description: This file defines the ProjectJjwg_MapsLogicHook class, which contains logic hook methods for handling geocode updates and relationship events related to maps within the SuiteCRM project. It interacts with the jjwg_Maps module for geocoding and updates based on save, relationship addition, and deletion events.

classes.name: ProjectJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A class encapsulating logic hook methods for updating geocode information and related entities within the SuiteCRM Maps module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the jjwg_Maps property with module information.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Triggered before saving a bean to update its geocode info if the logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Triggered after saving a bean to update geocode info for related meetings if enabled.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Triggered after adding a relationship; updates geocode info for the related entity if conditions are met.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Triggered after deleting a relationship; updates geocode info for the related entity if conditions are met.
